i. For international order we accept payment only via PayPal. Payment will be issued only in USD. If you wish to make payment in other currencies please contact our Customer Support Team at

Our 7-day return policy gives you time to make sure your purchase is perfect. If you need to return it for any reason, we'll happily provide You with a full refund or exchange, within 7 days of the date of delivery of the order. This is, however, applicable for orders within India only.For international orders with international shipping we currently do not accept any returns or exchanges.
The Company/ Website offers a Limited Lifetime Exchange Policy. The policy is applicable on all the purchases made from the website within India subject to certain conditions.
a. Return any product to the company after seven (7) days under the lifetime exchange policy and buy any new product of your choice form the website.

b. Jewellery products made of studded diamonds shall be exchanged at eighty percent (80%) of prevailing market value and Jewellery products made only of gem stones shall be exchanged at seventy (70%) of the present prevailing market value.
c. Plain gold jewellery and gold coins shall be exchanged at the present prevailing gold rate.
d. The company shall determine the prevailing market value for the exchange purpose.
e. Silver Jewellery products cannot be exchanged under this policy.
f. Product should be accompanied by original Invoice. Submission of the original Invoice is compulsory under the Lifetime Exchange Policy.

g. In case of a refund under this policy, payment of the balance refund amount shall be made by way of an online bank transfer to the customer’s (Company/Website) bank account within ten (10) days of receipt of the product.

h. In case the exchange value of the old product is lower than the value of the new product, the user will have to pay the difference between the new product chosen and the valuation of the old product.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions at Gehna | Custom-Made & Designer Jewellery Shopping Online in India
text: Frequently Asked Questions at Gehna | Custom-Made & Designer Jewellery Shopping Online in India
Who are you guys? What makes Gehna different?

Encouraging a luxury culture for bespoke items, Gehnahas been a pioneer in offering jewellery personalization services to the discerning connoisseurs of fine jewellery. You can explore more about Gehna here.
We have our flagship store in Harrington Road, Chennai, India.   To   book   an   appointment   with   our   Personal Shopping Consultant, please click here.
Do you have a piece I'm looking at in stock?

We   have   some   of   our   pieces   in   stock   at   our   Flagship store in Chennai. Please check with our  Customer Care Team  if you'd   like  to  try   the  piece  before   buying  it  on our website.
Can I see the piece on a model?

If   the   piece   is   in   stock   at   our   store   in   Chennai,   our Customer Care Team can take a picture of the piece on a model for you. Alternatively our amazing design team can show how the piece looks on a virtual mannequin. Reach out to us on Whats App at +91-9360254044 to request the service.
Most of the jewelry is hand-made at our workshop in Chennai, India. Some of the designs are outsourced to our manufacturing partners across India.
Do you have a warranty on your jewellery?

Yes, we have a one-year warranty on all our jewelry and a   7-day   satisfaction   guarantee   return   policy.   The   one-year warranty is valid for quality of our workmanship. If you damage a piece, we'd be happy to repair it for you at   a   reasonable   price.   The   warranty   is   void   if   another jeweler resizes or modifies the pieces, since alterations,when   done   incorrectly,   can   damage   the   gems   or   the strength of the setting.
Why should I sign up for your account?

By signing up for an account with Gehna you can avail the following benefits: a) Access to your order history. b)   Quicker   check   out   with   address   book   and   billing information. c)   Password-protected   Wish   List   and   access   from anywhere. d)   Receiving   personalized   offers,   discounts   and   more from Gehna.
Why should I subscribe to your newsletter?

By   subscribing   to   the   Gehna   newsletter   you   get previews to our new design collection before they're on the website. Every month we also update you with our new blog posts and occasionally provide our customers with       discount       coupons       and       special       offers.
Do you sell gift-cards or gift certificates?

Yes. Gehna Gift Cards allow you to give a special person in your life the pleasure of creating a dream that comes true:   a   one-of-a-kind   piece   of   jewelry,   made   just   the way he/she designed it. Can you imagine a better way to guarantee that your present will fit her/him in every way? Please reach out to our Customer Support Team at +91-9840702969   for   more   details   on   the   Gift   Cards.
I cannot find the piece anymore on the website. Can I still order it?

We   do   occasionally   update   our   selection   and   remove pieces we used to offer. In case you are not able to find the   piece   on   our   website   anymore,   please   call   our Customer   Care   at   +91-9840702969   or   email   us
Why did the price change on the piece I have been planning to purchase? Can I lock the price?

At   Gehna,   we   handcraft   every   piece   of   jewellery   from scratch. We do so to ensure you get exactly what you want. Our team constantly works to make sure we find the   highest   quality   gemstones   and   precious   metals. This   is   the   level   of   service   our   customers   count   on and because   of   this,   prices   we   pay   to   our   suppliers   may vary, hence we update the prices based on the trends in the   market.   Sometimes   prices   may   go   up   and sometimes they will go down, (yes, really! ;)). This is the reason you are seeing a different price today than you may   have   seen   in   the   past.   But   the   most   important thing is that you can rest assured you are getting the highest   quality   gemstones,   metals,   and   workmanship from us.

We currently offer free shipping in India for purchase of any product on our website. For international shipments please refer to the charges at the time of checkout or alternatively please contact us via Whats App at +91-9360254044 for more details.
What is the estimated delivery time?

Delivery time of the piece depends on availability. If we do not have the piece in stock, we will have to hand-craft it for you. Once you add a piece to the cart with your postal address, we will tell you the estimated delivery time. In most cases, if the product is in stock we take 2-3 days for delivery within India & if we have to make it to order, it takes about 10-14 days. International delivery varies depending on the country. Please contact us via Whats App at +91-9360254044 for more details.
All   our   products   are   securely   packed   to   avoid   any damage during transit. Please rest assured about safety of     your     beautiful     jewellery     when     you     order.
Can I check the status of my order?
Yes, of course! Feel free to get in touch with our Customer Care Team for any queries regarding the jewellery you have ordered.
Do you ship to countries outside India?
Yes we do ship outside India. Please note, the taxes & charges are as applicable. For more information contact us via Whats App at +91-9360254044 or email at
Can I check the status of my international order?
Please contact us via Whats App at + 91 - 9360254044 for more or email our Customer Care Team at
to help with the status of international orders
Is my package insured? Do I have to be home to collect my package?
All packages we send are insured. A signature and ID proof is required on delivery of order. You will receive an email that your package is on it's way.
How do I check if you deliver to my pin-code?
Please click here to check if we can deliver the jewellery to your pin-code.
How do I return my purchase?

We offer an exceptional 7-day money-back-return policy on any jewellery purchased with us. Send back your jewellery in original condition, with the jewellery invoice attached, for a full refund. All you pay is return shipping. Contact our Customer Care Team - +91-9840702969 for arrangements.
Will I have to pay for shipping my products back to you?
Yes, in case you decide to return a product, you will be charged for return shipment.
How long does it take to get a refund?
After receiving your returned order, our team would inspect it and credit the amount in 4-5 working days. It depends on your card issuer on how long it takes to reflect in your account.
Do you take return of International shipments?
Sorry, for international shipments due to logistic challenges we do not have a return policy.
Can I commission a custom design from scratch?

Yes, of course! Our talented designers would be happy to help customize a design from scratch. Visit our Customize page and please fill out the details. Also give Gehna Customer Care a call at +91-9840702969 and our personal shopping consultants would be happy to assist you.
Do you offer trial of jewellery for custom orders?
We offer trial of custom-made orders at our boutique in Chennai. If you'd like to take a trial please let us know and we'll make the arrangements for the same at our store in Chennai.
Can I order designs on your website with different gemstones & size?
Some designs are available with different size or shape of gemstones or we may carry something similar in the size and shape you want. Whats App our team at + 91-9360254044 or Email us at
Yes all our gemstones used in the jewellery are natural.
Yes all our jewellery is BIS Hallmarked. Stay assured of the best from us.
What is the quality of diamonds used in your jewellery?

All our diamond jewellery is made with EF-VVS graded diamonds. Incase you'd like to use diamonds of lower quality in any of the designs on our website, please get in touch with our Customer Care Team +91-9840702969 or just e-mail us at
with your specs and we will do our best to source them for you.
From where are your gems & diamond sourced?

It is not always possible to tell from where a gemstone or diamond originated after it has been cut and polished. But at Gehna we choose our suppliers carefully and do our best to assure that all precious & semi-precious stones we sell are responsibly mined.
Do you sell conflict free diamonds?
We at Gehna believe in fair trade practices. We take special care to source from vendors who sell only conflict free diamonds.
Can I order designs on your website with CZ stones?

We love creating heirlooms that last for generations. Why not trying beautiful gemstones like white sapphire or white topaz than using something that's made in a factory. Consider affordable colorful gems such as amethyst, citrine or garnet. You'll thank us later!
Can you make jewellery with our gemstones or diamonds?
Sorry, we do not undertake custom-made orders with client's gemstones & diamonds. Setting gemstones is a risky business and we'd rather not assume the risk of breaking or damaging your gem.
Do you match prices if an item purchased goes down in price later?

All sales prices are final and Gehna does not price match. Our prices are calculated using current prices of metal and gems to give you the best rate possible. These prices do change from time to time and our prices do too.
What happens if a ring I bought from your website does not fit me?

Gehna offers one free re-sizing within 15 days of delivery. All you have to pay is shipping. Re-sizing can take two-three weeks depending on the style. Some styles may not be resizable; we'll let you now before we complete your order.
Can I take the ring to local jewelers for re-sizing?

Of course, but we don't recommend it. We can't accept return of items that we have been modified by someone else. This also voids the warranty, because these modifications, when done incorrectly damage the gems or the strength of the setting.
What if there is a problem with my purchase?

Gehna offers one year warranty on all its products. Incase of manufacturing defect, we will repair it for free and pay for the shipping too. Please call or email our Customer Support Team & we'll be happy to address your issues. We want you to enjoy your piece and not leave it sitting inside the box!
What forms of payment do you accept?

We currently accept Master Card, Visa, American Express, Cash on Delivery & Net Banking through out payment gateway partner on the website. You can also send us a cheque. Just call us at +91-9840702969 & we'll help you with the details.
Is it safe using my credit/debit card on your website?
We offer 128-bit encryption to protect all information online, which is consistent industry practice. Please also read our policies in Terms & Conditions for details
Do you accept international credit cards?
Yes we do accept international credit cards
When will I get the delivery of my order?
Your order will be delivered within 4 working days after the payment of your last instalment.
Can I cancel the order if I am not able to pay? What happens to my money if I have not paid all my installments timely?

Yes, you can cancel the order or use credit for purchasing another product. However 10% cancellation charges will be levied if you choose to take refund. If you have not completed your instalments within your tenure or in a timely manner, the product price will be updated as per the current market value.
What if I do not receive the product even after making all my payments? What is the guarantee that I will get my order?
We have system generated emails sent to our customers for every payment made as well as the order status. Additionally, you can contact our support team at
or What’s App +91-9840702969 to receive an updated account statement.
Are there any documents required for this EMI?
No, there are no documents required for this monthly instalment plan. Add products to your cart & keep shopping!
Is there any fixed date that I have to make payment, what if I fail to pay on a particular month?

No, there is no fixed date. Payment is flexible, i.e. you can pay these installments at your convenience. Our support team will be in touch with you & send a payment link. However, it is mandatory to make on payment every month ( within 31 days of previous payment) and complete the payment within the fixed tenure, failing which you will be considered a defaulter. In case of defaulters, benefit of the plan will not be applicable and the price in the order will be updated according to the current gold rate on the website.
Would the EMI be deducted from my account automatically?
No the EMI will not be auto-deducted from your account. We do not store your bank or card details. Our customer support team will send you a payment request every month of the EMI amount.
What payment options do I have?
You can pay via Net Banking, NEFT, Credit Card, Debit Card or UPI transaction like Google Pay.
How do I pay my installments?
Our support team will contact you each month for the EMI payment via Whats App or Email and send you a payment link.
Yes you can pre-close your EMI if the prices of the products drop. Please contact our support team on Whats App at +91-93602 54044 and our team they will help you close the EMI.
Will discounts be applicable for my products?
Any discounts on the products at the time of down-payment will be applicable. In case there is discount on the product during the EMI tenure you will not be allowed to pre-close the EMI.
Can International customers avail this discount?
No this is applicable only for customers in India. Currently we do not have option for International customers. Sorry.
Is there a minimum Cart Value to avail EMI plan?
Yes the minimum cart value is 10000 INR to avail the EMI plan.
Can I cancel the order after completion?
Yes you can cancel the order. We deduct 10% fee on the current price of the product and will refund you the amount to you.

A real diamond produced in a laboratory under conditions that mimic earth’s natural processes. It has the same chemical composition and crystal structure as mined diamonds, giving it identical brilliance and durability.
Yes—lab-grown diamonds are 100% genuine diamonds. Their physical, optical, and chemical properties are indistinguishable from natural diamonds; only their origin differs.
(High Pressure, High Temperature): a carbon seed is subjected to immense pressure and heat, crystallizing into a diamond.
(Chemical Vapor Deposition): a carbon-rich gas is energized in a reactor, depositing layers of carbon onto a diamond seed until a full gem forms.
Are lab-grown diamonds ethical and eco-friendly?
Yes—no mining means no land disruption, no conflict-related concerns, and generally a smaller carbon footprint (especially when renewable energy is used).
Can you tell lab-grown and natural diamonds apart?
Not by eye. Both sparkle identically. Only specialized equipment or a microscopic laser inscription on the girdle can reveal a lab-grown origin.
Do lab-grown diamonds have flaws or inclusions?
Like mined diamonds, they can have microscopic inclusions. However, lab conditions often yield very clean stones. Each diamond is graded for clarity so you know exactly what to expect.
Will lab-grown diamonds lose their sparkle or become cloudy?
No—their crystal structure remains stable. Occasional gentle cleaning (warm soapy water and a soft brush) restores full brilliance instantly.
Do lab-grown diamonds hold their value?
They retain the same beauty and durability as natural diamonds but are not intended as financial investments; their true value lies in personal enjoyment and ethical sourcing.
Lab-grown diamonds engineered to display vivid hues—each is a real diamond whose color is built into its crystal structure.
How are colored lab-grown diamonds created?
During growth, specific trace elements are added or growth conditions are tweaked to impart color:
diamonds—each available in soft pastel tones up to rich, vivid saturation.
Are colored lab-grown diamonds rare or unique?
They’re more accessible than natural fancy colors but still special—each stone’s precise tone and saturation make it one-of-a-kind.
Are colored lab-grown diamonds more expensive than colorless ones?
Pricing varies by hue and intensity. Vivid colors can cost more than colorless lab diamonds, but all remain far below comparable natural fancy-color prices.
How are colored lab-grown diamonds graded?
grade (Fancy Light, Fancy Intense, Fancy Vivid) based on hue, tone, and saturation, alongside standard clarity and cut grades.
Will the color ever fade or change?
No—the color is permanent, embedded in the diamond’s crystal lattice, and won’t alter with normal wear or cleaning.

celestial-navaratna-18k-gold-bracelet.name: Celestial Navaratna 18K Gold Bracelet (7 Inches)
celestial-navaratna-18k-gold-bracelet.description: Experience the magic as you slip on Gehna's Navaratna Stones Bracelet, effortlessly infusing your look with luxury. Each stone tells a story; each color is a chapter in your journey of self-expression. Step into a realm of unparalleled elegance and let Gehna be your guide to transcendent beauty and timeless sophistication.

faq.q: Are these bracelets suitable for daily wear?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely! Our bracelets are crafted in 18K gold and designed to be lightweight yet durable, making them perfect for everyday wear. Each piece goes through strict quality checks before shipping.

faq.q: Can the length of the bracelet be customised?
faq.a: Most of our bracelets are designed to fit standard wrist sizes, typically 6.5 inches and 7 inches, which comfortably suit most clients. That said, we’re happy to customise the length for you if needed. Just reach out to us with your preferred fit, and our team will guide you through the process.

faq.q: What happens if I do not like the bracelet?
faq.a: No worries at all! We offer a 7-day return policy. If you’re not happy with the bracelet after receiving it, we’ll arrange a pickup from your address. You can choose between a full refund or select another product of your choice—we’re here to make sure you absolutely love what you wear.

faq.q: Is this jewelry piece BIS hallmarked?
faq.a: Yes, all our gold jewellery pieces are  BIS hallmarked , ensuring certified purity and quality. You’re buying fine jewellery you can trust.

faq.q: Are these Navratna stones real and certified?
faq.a: Yes, all  navratna gemstones are natural and certified  by a  third-party gemological lab , ensuring authenticity and purity.

verdant-whisper-emerald-18k-gold-ring.description: An enchanting row of pear-shaped emeralds comes together in an effortless eternity design, creating a delicate rhythm of green around the finger.
